I will keep this ticket for now.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0407423-DC/Si-D/CZ-[etq50E] Multiple Error Flags CRM:00798001890
additional_info.body:
Hi Milan and Tomas, good morning :)
Thank you for your efforts yesterday, you saved the day.
Here is a short summary of yesterday's site visit:
A valid question from your side where it seems misleading in the instructions:
I discussed this with L3 and seems like a misleading drawing, this grey part is not included as far as we know, but we don't do this task everyday so we cannot confirm 100%. This could be something to refer to SSP.
After pumping the liquid, we got the charger online but with CAN communication lost.
After checking the XD12 High and Low, we fixed the problem.
Then we could go into charge but failed in P03_Cable_Check
The contactors QA13-14 were not closing properly even though we had 25V at the energizing coil and the feedback closing.
You placed a contactor in parallel to confirm if it was working, it worked and afterwards we could charge properly.
I don't have a clear answer on why this worked to be honest, it could be coincidence.
The idea here is that the contactor is already showing signs of getting stuck, please monitor this charger for this issues, if you face more of this contactors not closing, I recommend you to replace the contactors.
Since the issue is resolved I will proceed to close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
